title: ERP 로 넘어간 뒤 고치기 — 금액·사진

steps.noText: 이 바이어는 매입 등록이 막혀 있습니다

steps.check: (안전) 사진 0장 — GPU PC 를 안 부름
steps.db: select sum(kind = 'sales_photo') as photos, (select payee_extraction_status from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) as ext from inspection_photos where purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null)
select status, car_erp_vehicle_id, (sale_price = 9000) as sale_ok from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null

steps.check: 고른 바이어가 정확히 BOARD CHECK TRADING 2(purchase-confirm 이 1번 바이어를 잠그므로)
steps.db: select car_erp_buyer_name as b from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null

steps.check: ERP 전환완료 차에 금액 다시 보내기 칸

steps.db: select (sale_price = 9300) as sale_ok, offer_currency from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null

select count(*) as n from integration_events where target = 'car_erp' and event_type = 'purchase_sync' and response_status between 200 and 299 and purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) and created_at >= ?

select count(*) as n from board_audit_logs where action = 'erp_overwrite_send' and purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) and created_at >= ?

steps.check: 사진 1장 추가(첨부 2건) · 정보 찾기는 다시 안 돎
steps.db: select count(*) as n, sum(kind = 'sales_photo') as photos, (select payee_extraction_status from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) as ext from inspection_photos where purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null)

select count(*) as n from integration_events where target = 'car_erp' and event_type = 'purchase_sync' and response_status between 200 and 299 and purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) and created_at >= ?

steps.check: ERP 차량은 하나뿐(새로 만든 건 첫 확정 1건 · 재전송은 200)
steps.db: select sum(response_status = 201) as created, sum(response_status = 200) as resent from integration_events where target = 'car_erp' and event_type = 'purchase_sync' and purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) and created_at >= ?
select (sale_price = 9300) as sale_ok from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null
